title: Pick Up Lines for Girls: 95 Cheesy, Funny and Bold Lines
h1: Pick Up Lines for Girls: 95 Cheesy, Funny and Bold Lines to Use on Your Crush
description: Pick up lines for girls who like to make the first move: 95 cheesy, funny, smooth, sweet and nerdy lines, plus texting openers and tips for delivery.
excerpt: Ninety-five pick up lines for girls who like to make the first move, from groan-worthy cheesy ones to smooth, sweet and nerdy openers that start real conversations.
intro:
Who says the guy has to make the first move? A playful pick up line is one of the easiest ways to break the ice, show you’re confident and make someone laugh in the process. And when a girl delivers a line with a grin, it tends to land even better because it’s unexpected.

Below you’ll find 95 pick up lines for girls to use on a crush, a cute stranger or the guy who keeps “accidentally” ending up next to you. They’re grouped by vibe, from cheesy and funny to smooth, sweet and nerdy, plus a set made for texting. You’ll also get a few quick tips on delivery so your line becomes the start of a real conversation.
body:
How to use these pick up lines

A pick up line isn’t a magic spell. It’s an icebreaker, and its real job is to make him smile so you can start talking. A few pointers:

  • Own the cheese. Say it with a smile and a little self-awareness. Laughing at your own line is part of the charm.
  • Read the room. Playful lines work at parties, bars and casual hangouts. In a quiet setting, a simple “hi” might be better.
  • Have a follow-up ready. After the laugh, ask a real question: “Okay, now that I’ve embarrassed myself, what’s your name?”
  • Take no gracefully. If he isn’t interested or seems uncomfortable, smile, say “worth a shot” and move on.
Tip: Match the line to the guy. A gamer might love a nerdy line, while a sweet, shy guy may respond better to something warm than something bold.

Cheesy pick up lines for girls

Gloriously corny. These work because everyone knows they’re ridiculous.

  1. Are you a parking ticket? Because you’ve got “fine” written all over you.
  2. Do you have a map? I keep getting lost in your eyes.
  3. Is your name Wi-Fi? Because I’m feeling a strong connection.
  4. Are you a magician? Every time I look at you, everyone else disappears.
  5. Do you believe in love at first sight, or should I walk past you one more time?
  6. Are you made of copper and tellurium? Because you’re Cu-Te.
  7. If you were a vegetable, you’d be a cute-cumber.
  8. Is it hot in here, or is it just you?
  9. Are you a camera? Every time I look at you, I smile.
  10. Do you have a Band-Aid? I scraped my knee falling for you.
  11. Are you a bank loan? Because you’ve got my interest.
  12. If you were a fruit, you’d be a fine-apple.
  13. Are you a campfire? Because you’re hot and I want s’more.
  14. I must be a snowflake, because I’ve fallen for you.
  15. Do you like raisins? How do you feel about a date?
  16. Is your dad a boxer? Because you’re a knockout.
  17. Are you French? Because Eiffel for you.
  18. You must be tired, because you’ve been running through my mind all night.
  19. Is there an airport nearby, or is that just my heart taking off?
  20. Are you a keyboard? Because you’re just my type.

Funny pick up lines for girls

Make him laugh first, and the conversation takes care of itself.

  1. I’m not a photographer, but I can definitely picture us together.
  2. My friends bet I couldn’t start a conversation with the cutest guy here. Want to help me win some money?
  3. Are you free tonight, or will it cost me a drink?
  4. I was going to wait for you to come talk to me, but I’m impatient.
  5. Do you have a name, or can I just call you mine?
  6. I think there’s something wrong with my phone. Your number isn’t in it.
  7. You look like someone who gives great restaurant recommendations. Want to prove it over dinner?
  8. On a scale of one to America, how free are you Friday night?
  9. My horoscope said I’d meet someone interesting today. No pressure.
  10. Is your name Google? Because you have everything I’ve been searching for.
  11. I’m writing a book on the best things in this town. Can I get your number for research?
  12. I promised myself I’d talk to one stranger today. Congratulations, you won.
  13. Do you know what my shirt is made of? Girlfriend material.
  14. If you were a burger at McDonald’s, you’d be the McGorgeous.
  15. I’d tell you a joke about pizza, but it’s a little cheesy. Kind of like this line.
  16. Want to do nothing together this weekend? I’m great at it.
  17. Do you play soccer? Because you’re a keeper. Also, I need someone to reach the top shelf.
  18. Are you a dog person or a cat person? Asking because my dog needs to approve you.
  19. I lost my number. Can I have yours?
  20. Somebody call the cops, because it’s got to be illegal to look that good while ordering a smoothie.

Smooth and confident pick up lines

Less goofy, more bold. Deliver these with eye contact and a little smirk.

  1. I noticed you noticing me, so I figured I’d save you the trouble.
  2. Hi. I’d use a pick up line, but I’d rather just talk to you.
  3. You have a great smile. I had to come see it up close.
  4. I don’t usually do this, but you seem worth making an exception for.
  5. I’ve decided you’re buying me a coffee. Just kidding. I’ll buy, you talk.
  6. So, are you going to ask for my number, or do I have to do everything?
  7. You look like trouble. I like that.
  8. I’m usually shy, but you made me brave.
  9. I bet you hear this all the time, but your laugh is contagious.
  10. You seem like the most interesting person in this room. Prove me right.
  11. I was told to go after what I want. So, hi.
  12. Let’s skip the small talk. What’s the best thing that happened to you this week?
  13. I think we should get to know each other. Starting now.
  14. Your vibe is very “someone I’d like to have dinner with.”
  15. You can stop pretending you weren’t going to come talk to me.

Sweet and romantic pick up lines for girls

For when you want to be charming rather than cheeky.

  1. I don’t know your name yet, but I already want to hear you say mine.
  2. If kisses were snowflakes, I’d send you a blizzard.
  3. I didn’t believe in fate until I sat next to you.
  4. Your smile just made my whole day better.
  5. I’d like to know you better. Is that okay with you?
  6. I was having an ordinary day until you walked in.
  7. You look like the kind of guy who gives the best hugs.
  8. Something about you makes me want to stay a little longer.
  9. If I could rearrange the alphabet, I’d put U and I together.
  10. I think my heart just skipped a beat. Do you know first aid?
  11. I hope you don’t mind, but I’ve been smiling at you for a while.
  12. Are you a star? Because I can’t stop looking up at you.
  13. Every love song suddenly makes sense.
  14. You seem like the perfect person to share dessert with.
  15. I think we’d make a great story. Want to write the first chapter?

Want more in this mood? Browse our romantic pick up lines.

Nerdy and clever pick up lines

Perfect for science fans, gamers, bookworms and anyone who appreciates a good pun.

  1. Are you made of oxygen and magnesium? Because you’re OMg.
  2. You must be the square root of negative one, because you can’t be real.
  3. I’m like a library book. Want to check me out?
  4. Are you a black hole? Because I’m being pulled in.
  5. Player two has entered the game.
  6. You must be a 90-degree angle, because you’re looking right.
  7. Are you a carbon sample? Because I want to date you.
  8. My love for you is like pi: irrational and never-ending.
  9. Are you a loading screen? Because I’ve been waiting for you all night.
  10. If you were a triangle, you’d be acute one.

Pick up lines for texting your crush

Great for dating apps or a new number. Pair them with a real question to keep things going.

  1. I was going to wait for you to text first, but I’m not that patient.
  2. Quick question: coffee or drinks? I’m planning our first date.
  3. Is it weird that I already miss talking to you?
  4. Your profile says you love hiking. Mine says I love people who love hiking.
  5. Fair warning: I’m about to be very charming.
  6. Let’s settle this: pineapple on pizza, yes or no? Our future depends on it.
  7. I have a theory that you’re even cuter in person. Can we test it?
  8. On a scale of one to ten, you’re a nine, and I’m the one you need.
  9. Hey, I just wanted to tell you that you made me smile today.
  10. Do you believe in love at first text?
  11. I’ve been told I give great recommendations. Want to see what I’d pick for our first date?
  12. Okay, I’ll admit it. I’ve been thinking about our conversation all day.
  13. My phone keeps showing your name. I think it’s trying to tell me something.
  14. What are you doing Saturday? Asking for me.
  15. I don’t usually make the first move, so feel honored.

For more texting help, see how to start a conversation with a guy over text.

What to say after the pick up line

The line opens the door; the conversation keeps it open. Try one of these follow-ups:

  • “Okay, that was terrible. I’m ___. What’s your name?”
  • “Now that I’ve made it awkward, tell me something about you.”
  • “What are you drinking? I want to know your taste.”
  • “Are you here with friends, or did you come for the questionable music?”
Tip: Pay attention to his reaction. If he laughs and asks questions back, keep going. If he gives short answers or looks away, he may not be in the mood, and that’s okay.

More lines to try

If you love a good groaner, our cheesy pick up lines for him and hilarious pick up lines have plenty more. Looking for lines a guy can use? Check out pick up lines for guys, or browse the full pickup lines collection.
takeaways: A pick up line is just an icebreaker; the follow-up conversation matters most.
Say cheesy lines with a smile and a bit of self-awareness.
Match the line to the guy and the setting.
Have a real question ready to follow the line.
If he isn’t interested, take it lightly and move on gracefully.

faq.q: Do pick up lines work for girls?
faq.a: They often work well, partly because many guys rarely get approached and find it flattering and fun. A playful line shows confidence and humor. Success depends more on your smile, delivery and follow-up conversation than the exact words, so pick one that feels natural to you.

faq.q: What is a good pick up line for a girl to use on a guy?
faq.a: Lighthearted, confident lines tend to work best, such as “I noticed you noticing me, so I figured I’d save you the trouble” or “Is your name Wi-Fi? Because I’m feeling a connection.” Follow it with a real question so the conversation can flow naturally.

faq.q: How do you use a pick up line without being awkward?
faq.a: Embrace the cheesiness, smile, and acknowledge the line with a laugh if needed. Keep eye contact, say it clearly and immediately follow up with a genuine question. Being relaxed about the outcome makes even a corny line feel charming instead of awkward.

faq.q: Should I use pick up lines over text?
faq.a: Yes, a playful line can be a fun opener on dating apps or with a new number. Pair it with something personal from his profile or your last chat, and ask a question to keep the conversation moving. Avoid sending several lines in a row without replies.
